registration_attestation_cancelled: Device verification was cancelled or timed out. Try again and confirm with your PIN or biometrics.
client_too_old: This NYX version is too old to keep working with the server (minimum {{minimum}}). Reload the page — if it stays the same, close and reopen the app (PWA) or reinstall it from the NYX site.
client_version_too_old_body: This build ({{version}}) is older than the minimum this server accepts ({{minimum}}). Every request is being refused, so messages will keep failing until the app is updated.
client_version_required_body: This server accepts builds from {{minimum}} upward and only allows changes (sending, editing, deleting) when the build states its version. This build reports {{version}}. Reading still works; reload to send again.
client_version_pwa_hint: If reloading changes nothing, close every NYX tab — and if this is an installed app, reinstall it from the NYX site.
api_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.

api_blind_auth_required: This action needs the secret issued when it was created, and this device doesn't have it.

api_unverified_limited: Unverified accounts are limited. Verify your account to unlock this.
